_rules._comment: This file is managed by PM Command Center. Developers may update task status, progress, notes, priority, and assignee. Do NOT rename tasks or milestones — matching is fuzzy but names must stay close to the original.

statusDescriptions.blocked: Cannot proceed — add a note explaining why

_rules.notes: Optional free-text. Use to explain blockers, decisions, or context for the PM.
_rules.assignee: Username or display name of the assigned team member. Set to null to unassign.
_rules.dueDate: ISO 8601 date string (e.g. "2026-04-01"). Set to null to clear.

tasks.notes: No file storage model or upload endpoint. Needs RIS/INFRA decision.

tasks.notes: No patient portal or public result URL. Blocked — requires Oracle EROS.

tasks.notes: Sendout table created. CRUD API + service built. SendoutPanel now persists records on send, with tracking sub-tab showing status lifecycle (Sent→Received→Completed). Referral Slip PDF still generates. Remaining: full EROS integration.

tasks.name: Refer patients for lab/imaging procedures
tasks.notes: Card enrollment module done. E-card issuance & release workflow built.

tasks.name: Track referral completion
tasks.notes: Sendout tracking built into Results SendoutPanel: summary cards (pending/received/completed), inbound receive + complete actions, outbound status tracking. Remaining: dedicated reporting view.

tasks.name: Monitor queue and operational status
tasks.notes: Operations Dashboard with stats + auto-refresh. 7-day trend sparkline charts added for daily queue visits and daily revenue (SVG sparklines, trend field in stats API, dashboard-client.tsx). HL7 resend button per transaction in edit-queue form (POST /api/transactions/[id]/hl7-resend).

tasks.name: Generate operational & workload reports
tasks.notes: 11 report types: bookkeeper, cash, cashier-summary, HMO, per-item, sendout, summary, amendment, census (daily patient visits + unique patients per day per branch), doctor-productivity (transactions + amounts grouped by doctor), corporate-soa (transactions per company with patient/queue details). CSV + XLSX export.

tasks.name: User authentication
tasks.notes: NextAuth v5 JWT, 2hr sessions. Session timeout warning modal added (src/components/ui/session-timeout-modal.tsx) — 5-min countdown with Stay Logged In / Log Out buttons, mounted in dashboard Header. Admin password reset done — POST /api/users/[id]/reset-password (admin/devteam, bcryptjs hash, audit logged), reset-password-dialog.tsx modal in Settings > User Management. Self-service forgot-password is a future enhancement.

tasks.name: Reliability & backups
tasks.notes: Backup/restore shell scripts created (pg_dump/pg_restore with retention, verification). Admin API endpoint (DEVTEAM-only) for manual trigger. Documentation in docs/backup-restore.md. Database Backup UI added to Settings page (DEVTEAM-only) — database selector (cms_v2, cms_audit, or all), Run Backup Now button with loading state and result display. Remaining: cron/Task Scheduler setup on production.
